hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); case "$b" in claude/*) echo "Cloud session: the branch $b has a generated name. Before the first commit, rename it after the work being done, in kebab-case and without the claude/ prefix (e.g. git branch -m marketplace-delivery-tracking), and push that name instead." ;; esac; exit 0
